name: Toshishita no Kare to Sugosu Natsu Matsuri.
original_name: 年下のカレとすごす夏祭り。
source:
Himegi Riko is a sophomore in high school.
She's got a younger boyfriend, Otonishi Haruta.
They agreed to go to a summer festival together.
After he meets her there, he asks what she wants to do.
How is Riko going to answer...?

[Translated from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/18060]Freem![/url]]
translation:
姬木梨子是高中二年级学生。
她有一个年轻的男朋友，音西春太。
他们约定一起去参加夏日祭典。
他在那里见到她后，问她想做什么。
莉子要如何回答……？

[译自[url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/18060]Freem![/url]]
